snippet.title: Compadrone: Land Wars Boss fight trailer 30s
snippet.description:
Compadrone is a family friendly top-down  #roguelite  arena shooter with elements of #towerdefense gameplay. You control a drone capable of wielding multiple weapons and fight hordes of alien warbots. Collect resources and XP to unlock new weapons, towers, abilities, and drones.

Steam link:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3841980/Compadrone_Land_Wars/

#familyfriendly #towerdefense #arenashooter
